prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: new full-bleed 16:9 conference title-slide background, landscape.
Primary request: a beautiful artistic iceberg that makes the enormous busy hidden system below the surface immediately obvious. The viewer knows only a little iceberg is visible above water; make the unseen part feel alive with work, layered activity and interdependence.
Scene: a calm dark ocean in a split-level view, above and below the water at once. A sharp horizontal waterline around 27 percent of frame height. In the RIGHT half, one unmistakable faceted iceberg has a modest clean tip above water and a much larger complete submerged body below. The tip is quiet, holding one small warm ivory finished-app-like glass object with no interface or lettering. Beneath it, the ice opens into a luminous translucent architectural cutaway: a richly detailed, ACTIVE hidden world of connected build and dispatch workshops. Distinct tiers contain parcel conveyors carrying kraft code-package crates, small mechanical assembly presses at work, cable looms, server-like machinery, brass rails and gantries, with warm pools of light. Interlocking routes and physical connectors link these different work areas upward to the tiny object at the tip. It should feel like a hidden working city inside the iceberg, with depth, not a static mass of frozen random gears. Convey activity through work in progress, moving belts, articulated mechanisms and small amber status lights; do not turn it into a dashboard.
Art direction: finely crafted painterly editorial concept art with subtle ink contours, rich tactile brushwork, translucent mineral ice, intricate but readable illuminated cutaway, dramatic restrained lighting. Serious and elegant, not cute, glossy plastic or an AI cyber poster. Cool smoke-grey and muted sea-glass ice against deep charcoal and petrol water, with the warm amber and brass light of a workshop glowing from within. Restrained burgundy cabling. The ice silhouette stays recognizable around the machinery, so the metaphor reads in a second.
Composition: entire LEFT 44 percent is calm near-black negative space for large native white title type, with only subtle dark sky above and dark water below. The iceberg and all important machinery sit in the RIGHT 53 percent, inset from the edges. Show almost the whole submerged silhouette, ending around 94 percent height, with a small dark margin below; make the underwater body much larger than the exposed tip. Keep bright machinery out of the left title area. The machinery should be clear at presentation scale, with a few large connected systems and finer detail rewarded on closer viewing. Strong silhouette and hierarchy, not an undifferentiated tangle.
Text: NONE. Native slide title will be added separately.
Avoid: readable text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, typography, floating icons, binary code, circuit-board patterns, shields, padlocks, neon cyan, purple gradients, holographic interfaces, hooded hackers, ships, animals, food or kitchens. Do not add text to the ice or machinery.
slide: Selected opening slide 1; other five opening title options removed. Title, event and author text remain native and editable.
